'''Tezirett seeds''' were a produce item found at the [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] marketplace. [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]] once served [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his companions tezirett seeds.
